==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am at a school where completing assignments earns you points. These points can then be traded in for mystical crystal weapons. These magic items can then be used to battle other students.

The assignments themselves are confusing. Even the teachers don't seem to understand them. I asked a teacher about how to do one of the problems, and she said that she doesn't actually grade them.

I hack into a wall of televisions in the school. The administration investigates, but I am never discovered. This feels like a place where the rules are practically meant to be broken.
